title: A sweep inside a group picks the layers in that group
goal: When you have gone inside a group to work on its pieces, dragging a band round three of them selects those three, instead of reaching past them and grabbing whole layers from the top of the document.
notes: Open thread carried by the last two manager passes, now confirmed in code: Sources/PhotonzCore/Document.swift:277 layerIDs(fullyInside:) filters the top level layers array only and never descends. There is no notion of which group you are in anywhere in Sources/Photonz (no activeGroup or enteredGroup), so the cheapest honest reading is the parent of the current selection. Canvas side is CanvasView.swift around line 1483.
acceptance: While the selection is inside a group, a rubber band sweep considers that group children and nothing above them
With nothing selected, or with a top level layer selected, a sweep behaves exactly as it does today
A sweep that catches a nested group still takes it whole, never half its contents
Shift sweeping adds to the selection within the same group

Ships unflagged as a fix to next-layer-groups behaviour. To see it: open Photonz Next, draw three rectangles, group them, double click into the group, then drag a band round two of the three and watch only those two get handles
Tests in PhotonzCore cover the inside-a-group case, the top level case, a nested group and the shift case before the app code is written
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task
